scope: The Patchgate receipts page, the shared receipt sheet in a run's Reviews tab, and the bounded first-change message and latest-decision time added to the authenticated receipt inventory. Not a qualification of Patchgate, the complete web service or any deployment.

capability.consumer: Operators and reviewers reading retained Patchgate receipts in the live console
capability.outcome: Find a receipt by its reviewed change or decision, then read what was decided, by whom, why and when before the exact identities
capability.durable_contribution: One receipt presentation shared by the directory page and the run tab, with one tested vocabulary for all nine normalized decisions
capability.repeatability: Repository-owned Node and Rust tests plus the bounded browser observations below

source.rust_verification_boundary: Rust tests and Clippy ran after the Rust formatting changes. Subsequent edits were receipt JavaScript presentation fixes, exercised by the final Node rail and browser checks, not Rust semantic changes.

environment.openssl: Existing Nix store OpenSSL 3.6.4 development output via pkg-config-wrapper 0.29.2, not the flake derivation
environment.node: Host Node v26.8.1, not the flake nodejs
environment.browser: Headless Chromium 157 via the omp browser helper
environment.cairn: Host executable with the repository's generated Cairn policy
environment.nix_develop: Attempt produced no output and was canceled before reaching Cargo. The prior graphics-standard change recorded a busy evaluation cache; that cause was not established for this attempt. Host-toolchain verification was used instead.

rails.scope: Final receipt JavaScript, native-context handling, decision and tally boundaries, list ordering and filtering, and the shared identity checks including receipts.css

rails.formatting: rustfmt --edition 2024 on the two changed review Rust files; no unrelated formatting

browser_review.method: Real working-tree console assets served by a throwaway loopback Node preview. /api/reviews and /api/reviews/NAME proxied to the real kiln_web_service::reviews::Browser in a throwaway Rust stores backend over a private receipt directory. The directory held seven readable receipts and four entries the API skipped. Run-bound report envelopes and the other console endpoints used synthetic preview data; the empty-directory case also used the real Rust reviews API, and unconfigured and unavailable cases used explicit preview responses.
browser_review.boundary: Synthetic receipts, one headless Chromium, and a local preview, not the deployed kiln-web-service executable, the actual Patchgate execution, Firefox, Safari, a physical touch device or a screen reader

observations.decisions: Accepted, rejected, escalated, blocked, waiting, pending, removed, reverted and unknown inspected in the legend, receipt list and selected sheets. Unrecognized values remain unrecognized; unreadable native reports retain their normalized decisions.
observations.information_order: Headline and tally, evidence-only statement, changes and their recorded context, review context, exact identities, verbatim native report and complete receipt
observations.producer_claims: Receipt claiming acceptance authority and lacking isolation shows both warnings; Kiln grants no acceptance authority
observations.filters: Needs attention returned five of seven preview receipts; toolchain returned inbox-review-0040.json; unmatched text showed an explicit zero-match state; Clear filters restored all seven
observations.url_state: Text and decision filter parameters committed to the URL and restored on reload
observations.hidden_selection: Filtering to toolchain while inbox-review-0042.json was selected left Serve on port 9090 selected, showed the selected-receipt-hidden notice, and retained both selection and filter after reload
observations.keyboard: ArrowDown and ArrowUp move between visible receipt links. Side-by-side selection keeps row focus; stacked selection moves to the receipt title; All receipts returns focus to the opened row
observations.copy: Change hash copy control reported Change hash copied
observations.headline: A receipt without a recorded message uses its file name as the headline without repeating it in the meta line
observations.run_receipts: Retained receipt uses the shared sheet and shows its run binding and Download exact receipt control. Declared-but-missing report says unavailable with no decision inferred. A run without a receipt explicitly says it is not a clean review and leaves its other reports under Tests & coverage
observations.absence: Empty directory, no configured directory, unavailable inventory and an exact missing receipt each read explicitly. Missing receipt is not substituted; its error statement is not duplicated
observations.error_punctuation: An API message lacking terminal punctuation reads as a separate sentence from the recovery guidance
observations.request_sample: 79 requests recorded in the keyboard, copy and headline inspection; all remained on the preview origin
